subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Revises consonant digraphs; uses consonant blends (sp-o-t, fr-o-g)

show.line: All our sounds together! Blends like fr and sp. Digraphs like sh and ch. Read anything!

rounds.prompt: Listen. fr, e, sh. What word is it?
Listen. ch, o, p. Tap the word.

rounds.text: The frog can spot a fresh snack.
accept: the frog can spot a fresh snack
the frog can spot a fresh snack.
frog can spot a fresh snack

rounds.prompt: Drink. Say the first two sounds together.
Starts with a blend, or a digraph? Sort the pictures.

hints: Blends keep both sounds. fr, sp, st.
Digraphs make one new sound. sh, ch, th.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! st, o, p is stop. Shop starts with sh.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's blend together. Stt, o, p. Stop!

parent_line: Can read words with blends and digraphs in sentences.
